keywords.title: Deploy
keywords.description: Fires once, right after the card is put on the board.

keywords.title: Deathwish
keywords.description: Fires when this unit dies, wherever the damage came from.

keywords.title: On kill
keywords.description: Fires when this unit finishes off a creature with its own effect.

keywords.title: Turn start
keywords.description: Fires at the start of every turn of this card's owner.

keywords.title: Turn end
keywords.description: Fires at the end of every turn of this card's owner.

keywords.title: React
keywords.description: The card reacts to the named event: it fires every time that event happens.

keywords.title: Melee row
keywords.description: Works only while this card stands in the near row.

keywords.title: Ranged row
keywords.description: Works only while this card stands in the far row.

keywords.title: Bond
keywords.description: The effect only happens if the named card is already on your side.

keywords.title: Leadership
keywords.description: The effect only happens while the strongest creature on the board is yours. A tie counts in your favour.

keywords.title: Weather
keywords.description: Weather sits on a whole row until the round ends. Playing weather on the same row replaces what was there.

keywords.title: Habitat
keywords.description: The effect only happens while the named weather sits on one of the opponent's rows.

keywords.title: Traitor
keywords.description: This unit is placed on the opponent's side and counts as theirs from that moment on.

keywords.title: Ahead
keywords.description: The first body straight ahead along the column: empty cells are transparent, the first body stops the shot.

keywords.title: Next to it
keywords.description: The cell to the left or right of this creature. Both taken means there is nowhere to put it.

keywords.title: Consume
keywords.description: Eats one of your own: it dies and the eater takes its power.

keywords.title: Summon
keywords.description: Puts a creature on the board, not from your hand. A summoned unit does not run its own Deploy.

keywords.title: Play from deck
keywords.description: The card is taken out of your deck, but you put it on the board yourself: the row and the cell are your call, not the server's.

keywords.title: Banish
keywords.description: Removes the card from the game: no graveyard, no deathwish.

keywords.title: Set power
keywords.description: Rewrites the base power of a creature. Healing brings it back only to the new value.

keywords.title: Boost
keywords.description: Adds power. It lasts until the end of the round and healing does not take it away.

keywords.title: Armor
keywords.description: A second bar: it soaks damage before power does and burns down. It does not count towards your power.

keywords.title: Heal
keywords.description: Restores power to the printed value. Boosts collected on top are not restored.

keywords.title: Pull
keywords.description: Moves the creature one row closer to you, if the cell is free.
